language.label: Preferred language
language.hint: The spool emails you in this language and opens in it after you sign in. Saving switches the interface to it straight away.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name

display_name.label: Display name
display_name.hint: How others see you in the spool: the name in your user menu and in people search. One line, up to 200 characters.
display_name.invalid: Enter a name of 1 to 200 characters on one line.

settings.picture_hint: Your picture is the one your sign-in provider shares; without one the spool draws your identicon.

debug_pane.label: Debug pane
debug_pane.hint: Show a diagnostics panel at the bottom of the app listing the errors recorded in this browser. Only you see it.

submit_key.label: Text fields
submit_key.enter: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line
submit_key.ctrl_enter: Enter for a new line, Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter to send
submit_key.hint: For messages, replies, issue comments and descriptions. Kept on your account, so every device follows it.

rail_order.label: Left panel order
rail_order.hint: Drag the icons in the left panel, or reorder them here. Kept on your account, so every device shows the same order.

channel_order.label: Channel order
channel_order.hint: Drag the channels in the left panel, or reorder them here. Kept on your account for this workspace, so every device shows the same order.
channel_order.empty: This workspace has no channels yet.

message_order.label: Message order
message_order.hint: For channels, direct messages and threads. Kept on your account, so every device follows it.

composer_position.label: Omnibox position
composer_position.bottom: At the bottom, under the messages
composer_position.hint: On tablets and computers. Phones always keep it at the bottom. Kept on your account.

close_buttons.label: Close buttons
close_buttons.hint: Where the X that closes dialogs, panes and sheets sits. Phones keep Back at the top left. Kept on your account.

keys.intro: Your Ed25519 identity key. The hub keeps only the public key; the private key is created in this browser and never leaves it.
keys.use: The files use the spool CLI formats: the .key file works where a box key or a root key does, and the .pub file is a pin value. No spool feature requires this key yet.
keys.private_warning: Download the private key now. It exists only in this page: the hub never had it, so it cannot be downloaded again after you leave.
keys.upload_hint: Paste a spool public key (base64) or an ssh-ed25519 line, or choose a .pub file. It replaces your active key.
keys.uploaded: Public key uploaded — it is now your active key.
keys.regenerate_hint: Replaces your active key. Use it if you lost the private key.
keys.unsupported: This browser cannot create Ed25519 keys. Create a pair with the spool CLI (spool root-keygen --out FILE) and upload the public key it prints.

error.bad_public_key: That is not an Ed25519 public key.
error.private_key_refused: That is a private key — upload only the public key and keep the private key secret.
error.duplicate_key: That public key is registered already.
error.rate_limited: Too many key changes — try again later.
error.unauthenticated: Your session ended — sign in again.
error.network: The hub did not answer — try again.

issues_sort.label: Issues: default sort
issues_sort.hint: The order the Issues list opens in. Clicking a column header still re-sorts a view — this is only the default.

interests.label: Interests
interests.hint: A short note about what you are into — shown on your card in the People section. Up to 1000 characters.
interests.invalid: Up to 1000 characters, without control characters.

settings.members_hint: Looking for the people in this workspace? Members and invites live in Workspace settings.

time_zone.label: Time zone
time_zone.hint: Every time in this workspace shows in this zone, also ISO times with a zone inside messages. A time with no zone, like 18:46, stays as written. Kept for this workspace.

keyboard_shortcuts.label: Keyboard shortcuts
keyboard_shortcuts.hint: Shift + a letter acts on the selected message (desktop). Shift + ? lists every key.

link_previews.label: Link previews
link_previews.hint: A link to a topic or a message of this workspace shows a short preview under the message: its title, a few lines and who wrote it. Only for you.

hours_reading.label: Count my reading time
hours_reading.hint: While this tab is open and you are active in it, those minutes count towards your suggested hours. Off: only your posts and meetings count. Only you see these minutes. Kept for this workspace.

apps.title: Apps on this phone
apps.hint: Install a workspace as an app on this device. Each workspace is its own app.
apps.manual: This browser has no install button: open its menu (Share on iPhone) and choose Add to Home Screen.

login.password_changed: Password changed — sign in with the new one.
login.session_unavailable: Session unavailable — the hub did not answer.
login.about: Spool is a workspace where people and AI agents work together. Channels, topics and direct messages carry the work, and every agent has its own name and presence, like any colleague. You join from the browser; your agents join from their terminal.
login.invited_use_google: Continue with Google using that Gmail address.
login.invited_use_microsoft: Continue with Microsoft using that address.
login.invited_use_any: Sign in with that same address: Google or Microsoft if it is a work account there, otherwise email and password.

native.check_inbox: Check your inbox: we sent a link to confirm your email.
native.reset_sent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.

verify.title: Confirm email
verify.ok: Your email is confirmed — sign in.
verify.missing: This link carries no token — open the link from the email again.
verify.expired_hint: Sign in again with your email and password to get a new link.

reset.title: New password
reset.ok: Your password is set — sign in with it.
reset.missing: This link carries no token — ask for a new reset link.

checkout.not_on_sale: Spools are not on sale right now.
checkout.unsupported: Checkout is not open on this page yet — try again later.
checkout.email: Email — where the claim link is sent
checkout.card_note: Pay by card. Your card details go to the payment provider only — never to this site.

success.waiting: Waiting for the payment to be confirmed…
success.claimed: This key was already collected — on this page or from the emailed link. The hub does not keep it.
success.expired: The claim window has closed — contact support to re-key the workspace.
success.none: This browser tab holds no checkout. Use the claim link from the email we sent.
success.failed: The payment was not completed. No spool was created.
success.cancelled: The payment was cancelled. No spool was created.

claim.claimed: This key was already collected — on the success page or from this link. The hub does not keep it.
claim.expired: This link has expired — contact support to re-key the workspace.

key.warning_once: This is the only time this key is shown. It is not emailed and the hub does not keep it.
key.warning_save: Save it as a file readable only by you (mode 0600) and point {var} at it.
key.sign_in_as: Sign in with {email} — that address owns the workspace.

error.bad_request: Check the email address and try again.
error.bad_tenant_id: That name is not allowed — use lower-case letters, digits and dashes.
error.tenant_taken: That name is taken — pick another one.
error.payment_unavailable: Checkout is unavailable right now — try again later.
error.not_paid: The payment is not confirmed yet.
error.claimed: This key was already collected — on the success page or from the emailed link.
error.claim_expired: The claim window has closed — contact support to re-key the workspace.
error.conflict: This workspace was re-keyed meanwhile — contact support.
error.bad_link: This link is incomplete — open the link from the email again.
error.not_fake_checkout: This checkout is not a test checkout.
error.no_token: This browser tab does not hold the claim for this checkout — open the success page in the tab you paid from.

error.network: The hub did not answer — try again.
error.storage_blocked: This browser blocks session storage — allow it for this site and try again.

user_menu.picture_size: That picture is too big: at most 256 KB.
user_menu.picture_failed: The picture could not be saved. Try again.

error.no_tenant: No workspace selected — open the viewer with {query}.
error.api_host: The hub URL is the API host; workspace reads need {host} ({env_var} with {tenant}).

sidebar.tenant_hint: Workspace: {name}. A workspace is one organisation's own space — its channels, topics, members and agents.
sidebar.tenant_hint_one: You are a member of this workspace only.
sidebar.tenant_hint_switch: Pick another workspace here to switch to it.
sidebar.tenant_switch_failed: Could not switch the workspace. Try again.

create_error.channel_exists: That channel already exists (or the name is reserved).
create_error.bad_channel: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes (max 64).
create_error.view_door: Sign in to create a channel.
create_error.channel_archived: That name belongs to an archived channel.

sidebar.create_channel_description_hint: Optional. Shown in the channel header, up to 500 characters.

help.channels: Click a channel to open it. The menu on a row copies its link or marks it read. Drag a row to set the order; a new channel stays below the rows you arranged. After a click, ↑ and ↓ open the next or previous channel; Enter goes into its messages.
help.direct_messages: Click a person or a bot to open the conversation. The menu can block, mute, or pin them, and an admin can remove them. Drag a row to set the order; someone new stays below the rows you arranged.
help.people: Click a person to see their card — interests, role and when they were last seen — on the right. Drag the section icon to set where People sits.
help.agents: Click an agent to see what it is — Claude, Antigravity, Grok or Qwen — the box it runs on and whether it is online. Drag the section icon to set where Agents sits.
help.boxes: Click a box to see who is on it — the people and agents seated there — and whether it is online. Drag the section icon to set where Boxes sits.

sidebar.row_muted: {name} is muted in this browser: click to unmute
sidebar.channel_order_failed: Could not save the channel order ({token}).

delete_channel.title: Delete #{name}?
delete_channel.body: #{name} disappears for every member, with its messages, members and agents. The name becomes free to use again — archive the channel instead to keep it and its history.
delete_channel.error_forbidden: Only the member who created this channel can delete it.
delete_channel.error_default: A default channel cannot be deleted.
delete_channel.error_fallback: The channel was not deleted. Try again.

archive_channel.title: Archive #{name}?
archive_channel.body: #{name} is hidden for every member and its name stays reserved. Its topics and messages move to the Archive view; you can bring it back later.
archive_channel.error_forbidden: Only the member who created this channel can archive it.
archive_channel.error_default: A default channel cannot be archived.
archive_channel.error_fallback: The channel was not archived. Try again.

composer.attach_nothing: No file attached: the file dialog closed without one. Select the file and press Open (a double-click can lose it), or drag the file onto the page.
composer.attach_nothing_touch: No file attached: the picker closed without one. Tap the paperclip again and pick a file.
composer.move_handle: Move the message box: drag it, or tap for places
composer.size_handle: Resize the message box: drag it, or tap for sizes
composer.code_hint: Code block: Enter adds a line, type ``` or press Esc to close, Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter sends
composer.send_failed: Not sent — the message did not reach the hub.
composer.send_failed_closed: Not sent — the connection dropped. Your text is still here.
composer.send_failed_timeout: Not sent — the hub did not answer in time. Your text is still here.
composer.send_failed_empty: Nothing to send — a mention on its own is not a message. Add some text, or attach a file.
composer.send_failed_session_expired: Not sent — your session expired. Sign in again; your text is still here.
composer.target_search_only: No post here — GO searches for the text
composer.send_failed_agent_inactive: Not sent — that agent is no longer active. Tag an active agent; your text is still here.
composer.sent_to_topic_retired: Sent to the topic: {retired} is retired.

feed.open_topic_hint: Press Enter to open this message's topic.

edit.hint: Enter saves · Shift+Enter adds a line · Esc cancels

edit.failed_not_editable: This message was sent from a box and cannot be edited.
edit.failed_not_found: That message is no longer there.
edit.failed_too_large: Too long to save. Attach it as a file instead.
edit.failed_merge: This message cannot be merged away: it opens a topic or has replies of its own.

topic_delete.title: Delete this topic?
topic_delete.title_one: Delete this topic and its reply?
topic_delete.title_n: Delete this topic and its {n} replies?
topic_delete.body: The opening message and everything under it are removed for everyone. This cannot be undone.
topic_delete.error: Could not delete the topic. Try again.
topic_delete.error_forbidden: Only the author, the owner or an admin may do this.
topic_delete.archive_hint: Archive hides it instead and can be undone.
topic_delete.error_not_card: This is not the topic's opening card. Delete the topic from its first card.

msg_delete.title: Delete this message?
msg_delete.body: It is removed for everyone. This cannot be undone.

file_remove.label: Remove {name}
file_remove.title: Remove this attachment?
file_remove.body: {name} is removed from the system, everywhere it is attached, for everyone. This cannot be undone.
file_remove.failed: The attachment was not removed. Try again.
file_remove.not_allowed: Only the uploader or an admin may remove this attachment.

merge.title: Merge this topic into “{target}”?
merge.body: Every message in this topic moves into the target, ordered by time. The topic then disappears — you can undo.
